head: Samsung News shuts down on 21 December
dek: Samsung is ending its Samsung News feed on 21 December 2026. Its widget stops updating, and Samsung hasn't named a replacement.
details: Samsung announced it in a notice inside the app. Personal data collected by the service will be deleted, except records the law requires Samsung to keep. The left-most home screen panel will likely show only Google Discover after that.
means: If you read news on your Galaxy phone's left home screen panel or in the Samsung News widget, that feed stops in December.
todo: Remove the Samsung News widget from your home screen, as Samsung recommends, and pick another news app or Google Discover.
